# Plushie Party (Fabric 1.21.4, client-side)

Plushies and fake mobs that only YOU can see. Nothing is sent to the server.

* K - open the menu    * N - place plush at crosshair    * M - place visual hay at crosshair
* Right-click a plush -> plush bounces, all fake mobs hop, you dance too (click again = stop)

## Build
Push to GitHub -> Actions tab -> "build" -> download the `plushie-party` artifact (the .jar).
Tag a commit `v1.0.0` to get the jar attached to a GitHub Release automatically.
Needs Fabric Loader + Fabric API for 1.21.4 in your mods folder.
